name: Chocolate bar
summary: Segmented chocolate bar with the foil peeled back and a broken corner, plain wrapper, for snack and sweets scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the bar rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~330 px tall); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot
